Name: (CP) Visual Enemy Variety
Author: TeaLovingLad
Description:
If you've seen a standard Slime, then you've seen them all. This goes for any other monster too.
Well, no longer!

[i](This mod doesn't remove the original sprites of the monsters)[/i]

[b][size=3]Avoid looking at the preview images, if you don't want to spoil the new variants![/size][/b]

This mod adds more visual variants to [i](most)[/i] base-game monsters, by utilizing [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] to spice up your adventures just a little more.
The variants can range from serious to silly, but provide more personality and stlye  in either case!

[b][size=3]This mod isn't finished yet, but offers a sizeable amount of variants for most of the monsters already!

[/size][size=2]The following is a list of all the monsters that [u]currently[/u] have no new variants:[/size][/b]

Special thanks go to...[/size][/center][/color][url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/VoidWitchCult]VoidWitchCult[/url] for providing the Gummy Duggy variant!

[b][center]Thank you for at least considering to download this mod.
Now go on and have a good one of whatever you feel like![/center][/b]

Downloads.Description:
Only works with Monster Variety 0.3.0 or above installed!

Fixes a missing comma.

This version adds variants for the standard Grubs and Spiders!



Simply drop the .zip file in your 'Mods' folder and you should be good to go.
